name: brain-device-viewer
description: 脳デバイスのSTEPモデルを分解して仕組みを見られるiPad向け3Dビューア

scripts.convert: python step-mesh.py && node step-colors.js && node to-glb.js
scripts.build: node build-standalone.js app dist && node build-standalone.js headgear/app dist/headgear
scripts.headgear:convert: cd headgear && python ../step-mesh.py "source/metaq brain.step" && node ../step-colors.js "source/metaq brain.step" && node ../to-glb.js
